author: ThioJoe
description:
Google Messages may send a random message to your contacts

There's a bug on Android that while rare, is potentially devastating, that users on Reddit have been reporting for months, and is finally only now getting attention. It seems to be related to Google Messages, but is not specific to one brand of phone. The bug involves someone sending a text, and then along with that text, it will randomly send some other text message, which may be any text you had ever sent or received before, from anyone.
